instruction: tests/test_stats.py fails because stats.py has no median() function yet. Add median(values) to stats.py. It returns the median of a list of numbers: the middle value of an odd-length list, or the mean of the two middle values of an even-length list, whatever order the input is in. An empty list raises ValueError, and the caller's list must be left exactly as it was. Don't change mean() or the tests.
